label: conj:lepton-mass-tower-canonical
title: Canonical operator-level lepton-mass-tower formula: there exists a categorical formula $\mathfrak{m}(K_\ell) = m_e \cdot \mathcal{F}_\ell(q)$ for each lepton $\ell \in \{\mathfrak{e}, \mu, \tau\}$ expressed as a per-braid Markov-trace-weighted sum over $K_\ell$'s braid representative, **without** invoking the superseded scalar substrate density $\rho_q = 1/\hbar_q^2$ as a dimensional factor.
html:
Conjecture. Canonical operator-level lepton-mass-tower formula: there exists a categorical formula \mathfrak{m}(K_\ell) = m_e \cdot \mathcal{F}_\ell(q) for each lepton \ell \in \{\mathfrak{e}, \mu, \tau\} expressed as a per-braid Markov-trace-weighted sum over K_\ell's braid representative, without invoking the superseded scalar substrate density \rho_q = 1/\hbar_q^2 as a dimensional factor.

Conjecture (canonical lepton-mass tower). Let \ell \in \{\mathfrak{e}, \mu, \tau\} be a charged lepton with canonical braid representative K_\ell. The lepton mass evaluates as:

  \mathfrak{m}(K_\ell)
  \;=\;
  m_e \cdot \mathcal{F}_\ell(q)
  \;=\;
  m_e \cdot \xi_\ell(q) \cdot \mathrm{Vol}_q^{\mathrm{tower}}(K_\ell).

The evaluation occurs entirely within the canonical per-braid mass tower, without invoking the superseded scalar density \rho_q.

The atomic graded expansion evaluates nuclear mass by adding constituent nucleon masses to binding-energy corrections. Leptons lack nucleon constituents. The isolated lepton mass requires a separate canonical formula.

The operative Skein formula evaluates the m_\mu / m_e ratio using the Kashaev limit \mathrm{Vol}(4_1)/\hbar_q^2. The direct operator-level Markov-trace ratio yields \sim 0.27, falsifying the Skein formula as a direct pre-limit identity. The canonical \mathcal{F}_\ell(q) must supply the missing magnitude at the finite substrate q_0.

Two-constraint obstruction. Any working \mathcal{F}_\ell(q) must satisfy two constraints simultaneously.

  1. Nonzero on torus knots. The electron T(2,3) and tau T(2,7) are torus knots. Their hyperbolic volume vanishes identically. The Skein formula fails to predict m_\tau / m_e entirely.
  2. O(10^2) mass ratios. If \xi_\ell(q) is a universal scalar, it cancels in inter-lepton ratios. The symmetric \mathrm{Li}_2^q tower yields O(1) ratios, missing CODATA values by factors of 30 to 130.

The symmetric \mathrm{Li}_2^q tower lacks the 1/\hbar Kashaev blow-up required to supply the O(10^2) magnitude.

Faddeev \Phi_q probe. Substituting the Faddeev quantum dilogarithm \Phi_q injects the required 1/\hbar enhancement but fails to reproduce CODATA. The muon 4_1 evaluation diverges severely near the \Phi_q convergence radius. The T(2,5) evaluation undershoots. The muon knot-ID split (4_1 vs T(2,5)) governs the divergence behavior entirely.

The isolated \Phi_q per-braid tower cannot close the lepton mass ratios. The mass generation requires the 4_1 Higgs coupling mechanism.
